entries.zh: 威实；〔西语词头语义不明，释义存疑〕
entries.en: to awe and make firm / prove one's authority; [Spanish headword 'Al bridas' unclear]
entries.notes: L栏 Al bridas 与 H栏 威实 难以互证（bridas 义为缰绳/束带），仅按汉字与对音给出存疑释义。

entries.zh: 贺喜；因喜讯而给的赏钱、道贺
entries.en: to congratulate on good news; albricias: a tip or reward given for glad tidings

entries.zh: 媒；做媒、牵线（的媒人）
entries.en: matchmaking; a go-between / marriage broker (cahuete)

entries.zh: 牵门线；做拉线撮合之人，引荐人；拉皮条（次要义项）
entries.en: to pull strings as a go-between / procure; alcahuete: a broker, pimp or procurer
entries.notes: H栏第二字为疑难字（縩/糸+蔡），按对音 mūy 定为'门线'之'线'系推断。

entries.zh: 内通；暗通消息、暗中牵线（的内线中人）
entries.en: inside mediation; to communicate secretly as an intermediary (alcahuete)

entries.zh: 官；官员、长官（alcayde/alcalde）
entries.en: an official, magistrate or governor (alcayde)

entries.zh: 狱官；监狱长、典狱官（alcayde mayor，大狱官）
entries.en: prison warden, keeper of the jail (alcayde de la cárcel); alcayde mayor: chief warden

entries.zh: 狱卒；地狱之守卒；差役、警吏（alguazil）
entries.en: a jailer / turnkey; warden of hell; alguazil: a constable, bailiff
entries.notes: M栏卒字声调记号 T99 污损难辨，释义按四栏文字互证给出。

entries.zh: 攀；向上攀、够取高处之物
entries.en: to climb up; to reach for something high (alcançar de alto)

entries.zh: 扳落来；把高处之物扳取下来
entries.en: to pull or bring down from up high (alcançar de alto y bajarlo)

entries.zh: 攀摘；攀枝摘取果实
entries.en: to pluck, pick fruit (reaching for it)

entries.zh: 浔〔疑为潯〕；求得所企求之物
entries.en: to attain what one aims at or seeks (alcançar lo que se pretende)
entries.notes: H栏'浔'为存疑字（疑：氵+尋），据 L 栏与对音 fit 定释义。

entries.zh: 浔力〔潯力〕；求人情、求得帮助
entries.en: to seek favor and help (alcançar favor, ayuda)
entries.notes: H栏首字存疑（疑：潯），释义依 L 栏 faboz(=favor)/aiuda 与 M/R 对音。

entries.zh: 扑灭；扑灭、扑打熄灭；账目上勾销结清〔存疑：L 栏谓在账目中，H 栏作扑灭，两栏难以完全互证〕
entries.en: to stamp out, extinguish; possibly to strike off / settle in the account
entries.notes: L栏 alcançar en la quenta（在账中讨得）与 H栏 撲滅 语义不吻合，释义存疑。

entries.zh: 到手；求得心中所愿之物，弄到手
entries.en: to obtain what one desires; to get into one's hands

entries.zh: 赶走；追赶而驱走，追上赶走
entries.en: to chase away; to catch up with someone going and drive him off
entries.notes: M栏趕字声调记号 T99 污损难辨。

entries.zh: 赶着；赶着去做、追上而使之
entries.en: to hurry to do, to catch up and press on (alcançarle yendo a hacer)
entries.notes: M栏着字声调记号 T99 污损难辨。

entries.zh: 应；答应、应承所求之事；付款、偿付（la paga）
entries.en: to respond to / comply with what is asked; to pay what is due

entries.zh: 应得；应得之分、理所当得之物
entries.en: to be due, to merit; what one is entitled to receive

entries.zh: 求得；恳求得之、求而后得
entries.en: to obtain by begging or entreating (alcançar rogando)
